subject: POC MAP: final access & cutover checkpoints (API keys, org, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:

Subject: POC MAP — finalizing access windows and keys

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is aligned on doing a 4-week evaluation and we'd like to lock the mutual action plan so we can sign the PO and start environment setup next week. Two asks from our side to confirm:

1) Who will create the initial API keys and service account? We prefer Redwood to generate the ephemeral keys and rotate after the cutover, but need the process documented.
2) Target maintenance window for VPC peering and IP allowlist changes — our infra team needs a 2-hour window and prefers a PST evening slot (after 22:00 PST).

I've attached the draft PO and a short checklist of items we need in the MAP (API key ownership, org invite, IP ranges, peering CIDRs). Can you return a one-page MAP with concrete dates and the preferred peer window?

Warmly,
Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Director of Platform Integrations | HealthPivot

Subject: Re: POC MAP — finalizing access windows and keys

Sofia — thanks, and congrats to the team for moving this forward. High level plan below; I'll attach the MAP spreadsheet with the schedule and owners after this note.

Planned owner model and steps:
- Redwood generates initial ephemeral service key (scoped to the test tenant). TTL 30 days; customer rotates after acceptance. (Owner: ben_carter)
- Org invite: we'll create a company-level evaluation org and invite up to 5 HealthPivot users for admin access. (Owner: marissa_cole)
- IP allowlist: we request an initial set of CIDRs from HealthPivot; Redwood will add those to the allowlist during the cutover window. We will stage the rules first in the staging subnet. (Owner: neha_kapoor)
- VPC peering: peer setup requires coordination with your infra (accepting side). Proposed peer CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 <-> 10.50.0.0/16. We'll share route tables and security group expectations in the MAP. (Owner: marissa_cole)

Proposed dates (assuming PO signed this week):
- Monday 2026-11-08: Redwood creates org & service key, shares secure credentials via vault link.
- Wednesday 2026-11-10 23:00-01:00 PST: VPC peering window (2 hours) — staging verification and traffic smoke tests.
- Friday 2026-11-12: IP allowlist finalization and perms check; customer acceptance testing begins.

We will prepare a one-page MAP and a short runbook for key rotation and emergency rollback. Also attaching the MAP_v2 spreadsheet and a Drive link with network diagrams.

Quick questions: can Alex (cc'd) provide the exact CIDRs and the preferred firewall change owner? Also confirm whether HealthPivot requires HSM-backed keys or if a Redwood managed KMS with audit logs is acceptable.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: HP-3472_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

Subject: Re: POC MAP — finalizing access windows and keys

Adding some technical specifics so the infra team has what they need in one place. Quoting Ben's schedule above and adding checklist items:

— Pre-cutover (by 2026-11-08):
  * HealthPivot provides CIDR list for allowlist and VPC peer target (example: 203.0.113.0/24 for jump hosts).
  * Confirm the five admin user emails for org invites.
  * If you require HSM-managed keys, send contact at your security team; we can shift to customer-managed KMS, but that will add ~3 days.

— Cutover window (2026-11-10 23:00-01:00 PST):
  * Redwood will create the peering request then validate route propagation.
  * During the window we'll enable a staged IP allowlist on the test tenant and run smoke tests (token issuance, small generation requests, embedding calls).
  * Rollback: remove peering or revert route tables + revoke ephemeral key if any failure > 10 minutes.

— Post-cutover (by 2026-11-12):
  * Hand off monitoring dashboard access and cost alerts.
  * Run acceptance tests (HealthPivot test harness).

I'll be the day-of technical point (mobile +1-415-555-0124). Neha will own the allowlist changes and will be on the call for verification.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
